answer: Require commodity price claims to match a quorum of at least five independent exchanges: the agent quotes gold or oil prices, and the verifier accepts only values inside the tight band where the exchanges agree. The ridge of real spot prices moves all feeds together, so a Sybil operator cannot push a fake price through one feed, and the inlet of small inter-exchange spreads bounds how far any single report can stray before the river of the quorum median rejects it as an outlier.
